summary: 10.0.36.04 Defect Fixes & Parity: Date Policy Centralization, Quotation Load Fix, Reminder Center Modernization, Top Shell Polling, and Reports/E-Way/GST Parity
highlights: 1. Centralized Date & Timezone: All 8 controllers, report viewers, and header/footer clocks strictly adhere to company format settings (DD-MM-YYYY) and user timezone.
2. Startup Logo & Mark Parity: Auth card branding automatically toggles mark card visibility when configured or cleared, matching desktop LoginController.java.

3. Reports & BI Initial Load & Saved Views: Dashboard automatically calculates 'This Month' dates on boot, loads cleanly via Promise.allSettled(), populates saved views dropdown on tab activation, and upgrades saved report actions to canonical purple dropdown.
4. Top Shell Notification Counters: Polled immediately upon successful post-login and maintained on a continuous 30-second background polling cycle.
5. E-Way Bill & E-Invoice (IRN): Resolved numeric saleId parameter for E-Way generation and added client-side JSON Blob export for official NIC E-Invoice upload.
6. GST Compliance GSTR-2B Reconciliation: Modernized period selection to dynamic 24-month dropdown and added live purchases reconciliation fallback when 2B cache is empty.
7. Quotation Register Load Fix: Resolved missing refreshAttachmentUi ReferenceError, restoring full quotation listing and pipeline KPIs.
8. Reminder Center Modernization: Upgraded KPI cards to standard .kpi-card with color borders and icon badges, and converted inline gray buttons to canonical purple ::: Actions dropdown menu.
